title: About Me
text:
##Welcome
Hi, my name is Emmanuel Laureano-Maravilla. I am 19 years old and currently a student at California State University, Monterey Bay, majoring in Statistics and Data Science.
This website will show my projects, coursework, and some work in data science.
This is my STAT 210 portfolio.
